# [ShadowClaw Draw](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw-draw/)

> Three-studio Vector (SVG), Bitmap (Canvas 2D) & Animation graphical drawing application built on ShadowClaw, Web Components, TC39 Signals, and WebMCP.

## Docs

- [README](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw-draw/README.md): Project overview, feature summary, and local dev/build commands
- [AGENTS.md](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw-draw/AGENTS.md): Conventions and guardrails for AI agents working on ShadowClaw Draw

## Pages

- [Vector Studio](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw-draw/main/): SVG path, shape, layer, Bezier node, and XML vector editor
- [Bitmap Studio](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw-draw/main/bitmap/): Multi-layer raster painting, GIMP-inspired blend modes & selections/clipboard, and Canvas filter pipeline
- [Animation Studio](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw-draw/main/animation/): Frame/keyframe Vector & Bitmap animation, Inkscape path-morph tweening, GIFWorks capture/trim, and offline GIMP GIF/APNG/Animated SVG export
- [Architecture & Tools](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw-draw/main/architecture/): System design, 15 Web Components, 36 WebMCP tools, and extensibility guide
- [Vector Studio Tools & Pen Editing](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw-draw/main/vector-studio-tools/): Complete reference for all 13 vector tools, Bezier nodes, Inspector, and shortcuts
- [Bitmap Studio Tools & Pixel Painting](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw-draw/main/bitmap-studio-tools/): Complete reference for all 8 bitmap tools, moved-layer coordinates, selections/clipboard, filters, and transforms
- [Animation Studio Tools & Export](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw-draw/main/animation-studio-tools/): Keyframes, tweening, capture, trim, and GIF/APNG/SVG/WebM/MP4/Sprite Sheet export
- [Porting & Attribution](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw-draw/main/porting-and-attribution/): Upstream provenance (Inkscape, GIMP, GIFWorks, x-canvas-image-manipulation, shadow-claw-daw)
- [Memory](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw-draw/main/memory/): Persistent site memory
